summary: The candidate is correct with no mathematical errors or gaps. Independent exact integer checks reproduce all 77 slacks, the complete census of 20 lattice points from all 136512 bounding-box points, all eight parity classes, all 16 distinct endpoint pairs, and the reflection counts one at the four vertices and three at the other 16 points. The barycentric argument proves census exhaustiveness and excludes unsupported centers. The Boolean product argument preserves full dimensionality and lattice convexity and proves the claimed cardinality, reflection maximum, and strict violation for every eta greater than 1/5; it makes no claim of violation at eta equal to 1/5. The indicator extension satisfies precisely the supplied predecessor's admissibility definition, including all zero lattice values, and yields the stated Hellinger normalization. The parity-pair bijection and integer inequality prove the vertex-deficit bound in the ambient dimension, including lower-dimensional and singleton supports, and show sharpness at 20 points in full dimension three.
